A.manual: Changed/critical read: sole production assembly; four bound families plus content/catalogue/cover/provider/SSE tails share the same leaves. Full Store only at assembly, not an HTTP field; no new universal facade. Source search and import audit supplement, not substitute, consumer tests.

R.manual: Changed/critical read: zero/negative subject is rejected, explicit anonymous remains separate. Facts are not mutable user projections; unknown completion does not invent page counts. Reader/OPDS/Mihon use the same bound queries.

Q.manual: Changed/critical read: subject enters SeriesListFilters before SQL filtering/count/order/page; retains query-shaped rows and batch SQL rather than per-book entity hydration. Cache invalidation is application-bound; browser scope includes reader/session.

W.manual: Changed/critical read: atomic write port exposes no DB/Queries escape. Committed book IDs survive later batch failure; soft activity error does not undo position. Original times/fact IDs and persisted clear basis survive retries/reopen; bookmark/time subject stays explicit.

M.manual: Changed/critical read: manual save includes required stats/read in the narrow transaction; absent vs empty collections remain distinct. Selection commits metadata atomically but later statistics are warnings. Source-specific seriesmeta policies remain separate.

P.manual: Changed/critical read: transaction rechecks pending state and current fields/locks/values, not just preflight. Partial fields/provenance roll back together; prior partial commit survives reject. Frontend waits authoritative reload, then finally publishes known commit; query retry never repeats adjudication.

C.manual: Changed/selected read: continuously derived members reject manual edits; snapshot/AI output stays manually owned. Ordered writes use a narrow transaction and preserve item identity; all-read list fallback differs intentionally from ordinary continue reading.

AI.manual: Changed/selected read: backend returns authoritative candidate and whole-review outcome. Existing applied members survive remaining rejection; frontend merges rather than guessing terminal state and retains selection/scroll.

F.manual: Changed/critical read: global desired/applied versions, not per-library graph; facts/cascade triggers mark in the same transaction. Stable identities and version guarded completion/failure prevent old attempts overwriting new success. Reopen/backoff and first-unavailable vs stale-success are separate witnesses; retry retains durable responsibility.

L.manual: Changed/critical read: reserve closes starts/reads/queued admission, cancellation outside Engine lock, actual coverage and task identity determine eligibility. Upgrade checks real occupiers under same lock; defer releases/resumes queue and restores current watcher after failure. Cancellations are not automatically replayed. Create/update distinguish save from scan/watch/navigation effects.

B.manual: Changed/critical read: same content source/cache/lease supports page and whole-book/protocol reads. Close ends file lease; materialized page bytes release archive borrow. Processing/pass-through and cache eligibility remain distinct; parser/images retain technical format, size and memory guards.

PUB.manual: Changed/critical read: stage first, return own source handle, bounded final borrow exclusion/revalidation, then replacement. File commit is recorded before bounded uncancelled fact/cache handoff. Warning is not write failure; the HTTP regression checks the next source read, not only a toast/run status.

X.manual: Changed/critical read: every registered library boundary is checked; each copy block passes pause and short IO lease. Resume checks source/staging identity, bytes/time, physical parent and destination eligibility. Atomic missing-target publication never clobbers a concurrent target. Committed IDs precede projection failure; cancellation removes only owned staging. No cross-process resume or forced OS IO interruption promised.

S.manual: Changed/selected read: ingestion owns discovery/identity/commit, successful reassociation effects occur after commit. Watcher coordinates actual scan completion/generation before cleanup, failed/uncertain work requeues; stop joins handed-off work. Scanner remains outside protocol ownership; asynchronous covers retain their own run.

I.manual: Changed/selected read: neutral byte/path evidence consumed by scan/maintenance, device document key and account remain protocol concerns. Retain size+mtime ambiguity and matching algorithms; evidence equality is not permission to merge book identity.

MOVE.manual: Changed/critical boundary read: persistent domain owns path/compensation/protection; application owns Engine exclusivity and watcher/cache handoff. Recover precedes input opening. Post-path-commit effects are not a fictitious database rollback.

CFG.manual: Changed/critical read: API and reload share Manager but retain separate compensation; startup facts identify active database and pending restart. Published is not all fields live. Fixed operation snapshots and FieldEffects retain next-operation semantics.

V.manual: Changed/selected boundary review: consumers request fetch/search/group/connection capabilities, not the provider superset. Adapters retain upstream format, paging, retry, cancellation and redaction; deterministic provider fixtures are not real-provider acceptance.

RT.manual: Changed/critical read: bind leaves before Start; Recover and resources/RecoverRuns before background. StopEvents precedes HTTP drain; Close joins task/watcher/background before resources retire. Runtime is an assembly result, not a handler field. Real routed SSE shutdown is a separate final-tree witness.

T.manual: Changed/selected boundary review: input Args, environmental Labels, Limits and metrics remain distinct. Lossy coalesces record each discarded input, lossless first-event suppression remains; restart does not infer behavior from trigger. Task/store/HTTP projections and context logs remain separate.

OFF.manual: Changed/critical consumer read: expiry/network failure clear auth but not owned bytes/queue; explicit logout uploads while authorized then releases ownership even on failure. New owner reconciles before new CSRF. Stable fact/time survives ACK/retry; browser mocks are not physical-device storage proof.

EDIT.manual: Changed/critical read: each partition retains baseline/version, prepare merges only that section with published server state, dirty receive does not rebase silently, acknowledgement retains edits after send. KOReader diagnostic request scope is separate from draft lifecycle.

FX.manual: Changed/critical consumer read: plain query/retry does not assert mutation. Known commit invalidation happens in finally after local authoritative reload settles, including refresh failure/navigation. Scope fencing protects the new view without suppressing shared effects of an old commit.

UI.manual: Changed/selected consumer review: unavailable/first failure, actual empty/zero and stale success remain separate. Identity/target and request generation fence late replies. Supplementary panel degradation does not pretend a required query succeeded.

ACC.manual: Changed/critical read: fresh actor and last-admin guard inside private write capability, self-delete forbidden and usernames byte exact. Password/session revocation commit precedes cache invalidation; replacement browser session can fail independently. Cookie/CSRF/rate/protocol auth stays transport owned.
